name: Inubou Amane
source: 1st year student at Cherry Tree High. May is the daughter of the owner of the candy store located next door to Unity Dormitory and has been friends with Miley since childhood. She trusts Miley completely and regards her as an older sister. May looks younger than her age and certainly doesn’t act it!
